chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power; what they signify.
chapter_note: The core teaching is the five-level cosmological identification of ‘happiness, wisdom, power’ across divine domains (¶5–¶8). The chapter opens with a clear hagiographic/dialogue frame (¶1–¶4). A strong editorial seam occurs when the patterned formula is extended to the institutional church (¶9), followed by a brief exhortatory/pastoral closure (¶10), consistent with the chapter’s pastoral drift signal.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic opening (‘Once again…’, ‘enlightener’, ‘disciples’, ‘assembly of the church’) is editorial frame language, not substrate exposition.

Introductory question/contrast with ‘the world’ functions as chapter setup rather than systematic cosmos→cosmos mapping; likely part of the compilers’ dialogue framing (though the explicit Q&A attribution is partly lost in lacunae).
Continues the rhetorical setup (‘People boast…’, ‘as I have told you’) in an address-like voice, without cosmological degree mapping; best read as introductory frame material.

Transitional didactic address (‘listen… I may reveal to you’) introduces the triad but still functions as a preface; the substrate proper begins when the triad is mapped onto specific cosmic beings/domains.

paragraphs.core_text: [The happin]ess of the glorious one is the Father, the God of [truth, who] is established in the great land of [light]. ⟨p.24⟩ His glorious wis[d]om is his Great Spirit that [ ... ] below, which flows through all his aeons, and t[h]ey float therein. His great power is all the gods, the rich ones and the angels who were summoned from him as they [ ... ] t]hey that are called aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic triadic identification (happiness/wisdom/power) mapped directly onto the highest Light-divinity and its emanated orders; impersonal cosmological architecture (Father, land of Light, Great Spirit, aeons) is characteristic of the core.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] which is called] the sun [ ... the ship of] living fire, [ ... the Third Amba]ssador, the second greatne[ss ... The] glorious [happiness] is the [Living] Spirit, [ ... , the wisdom] is the Mother of Lif[e ... and great power] is [all] the gods, [the] rich o]nes and the angels who are within the ship.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same triadic mapping, now to the solar ship and its indwelling deities (Third Ambassador, Living Spirit, Mother of Life); this is cosmos→cosmos identification in a repeated schema.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [h]appiness, wisdom and power exist in the s[hip of liv]ing waters [ ... ] the happiness [ ... ] the Mind of the Father. Also, wisdom [is the Vir]gi]n of [Li]ght. And the power that is [i]n the ship is [all] the go[ds], the [ri]ch ones and the angels who are established i[n it].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic iteration (‘Again… exist in…’) mapping the triad to the lunar/‘living waters’ ship and its hypostases; stable cosmological repetition indicates an older teaching template.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, these three exist in the elements: happiness, wis[d]o]m and power. The happiness is [the Pillar of Glory], the Perfect Man. Wisdom is the [five sons of the] Living Spirit; and great powe[r is ... the fi]ve sons of the First Man [ ... who are encl]osed and compounded in the totality, that [ ... ] while he supports the totality.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Extends the triadic schema into the mixed cosmos (‘elements’) and subordinate divine structures (Pillar of Glory/Perfect Man; five sons of Living Spirit/First Man), still purely internal cosmic mechanics (no institutional application).

Editorial seam: bridge connective ‘Now, moreover’ extends the patterned ‘Again… exist in…’ series into the contemporary institution (‘holy church’, Apostle of Light, leaders/teachers, elect/catechumens). This is cosmos→church pointing, not substrate mapping.

Exhortatory summary (‘Blessed… is every one who will know them’) and the institutionalizing phrase ‘in the five chur[ches]’ suggest a concluding pastoral/editorial application rather than an original cosmological degree statement.
